packs.name: First things
packs.description: The small set to fetch before anything else: what to have in the house, first aid, safe water, finding your way and the knots worth knowing. Small enough for a phone connection.

packs.name: Home preparedness
packs.description: For a household riding out a power cut, a storm or a longer disruption: official guidance on hazards, a post-disaster library, medicine, keeping food and making water safe.

packs.name: Medicine and first aid
packs.description: Reference for when a doctor is a long way off: emergency care, children, childbirth, essential medicines, altitude illness, and a medical encyclopedia to look things up in.

packs.name: Food and growing
packs.description: Growing vegetables, composting, and keeping what you grow: canning, preserving and plain recipes.

packs.name: Hills and navigation
packs.description: For walking, camping and the mountains: map and compass, map symbols, weather signs, knots, water, altitude, and answers from people who spend their time outside. Pair it with a map region from the Maps screen.

packs.name: Radio
packs.description: For listening and for licensed operating: questions and answers from amateur radio operators, signal processing, and marine weather fax schedules.

packs.name: Repair and making
packs.description: Keeping things working: community repair guides, vehicles, bicycles, electronics with Arduino, 3D printing, and how fasteners are chosen.

packs.name: General reference
packs.description: A compact shelf for looking things up: the most-read Wikipedia articles, a dictionary, a travel guide to the world, and country facts.

packs.name: Schoolroom
packs.description: For learning with no connection: a children's encyclopedia, Wikipedia in simple English, interactive science simulations, and college textbooks in maths, physics, chemistry and biology.

packs.name: Programming without the internet
packs.description: Language and tool documentation, the Linux manual pages, the ArchWiki and freeCodeCamp's courses. All of it together is small.
